panel.summary: Case-insensitive matching is gated on `checkedValue`/`uncheckedValue` being strictly `undefined`, so a rule that stores the defaults explicitly loses the fix
panel.evidence: `if (rule.checkedValue === undefined && rule.uncheckedValue === undefined)` (data-validation.ts:163). A rule that round-trips through an importer/serializer with the canonical defaults written out explicitly (`checkedValue: 'TRUE'`, `uncheckedValue: 'FALSE'`) is semantically a default boolean checkbox but takes the exact-match branch, so exactly the lowercase `'true'` values the doc-comment says arrive from xlsx/REST/paste render unchecked. Also, an empty-string custom value (`checkedValue: ''`) falls into the exact-match branch and `checkedValueOf` returns `''` (`??` does not fall back for `''`), so a cell holding `''` would be reported checked. No importer sets these fields today, hence low confidence.
